article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article104Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
To establish a periodically recurring right.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the plaintiff is first refused the enjoyment of the right.
